description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance, call out Essential Public Service to the Life of the Community
reasoning: This gazette content is an order by the President declaring certain services as essential public services under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. It establishes a legal/regulatory framework by specifying which services (electricity supply, petroleum distribution, and hospital/medical services) are deemed essential, making it a statutory instrument that creates compliance requirements. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel or structural changes.
